extraction.segment_function: Examines Hannah Arendt's concept of world alienation in the modern era, contrasting it with self-alienation and tracing its philosophical roots to Plato's cave allegory and Kafka's critique of modernity.

claims.claim: World alienation results in the loss of meaning of human existence and identity, as well as the loss of the shared common and public sphere.
